meta.title: 5 things Epictetus would tell you today

plates.want: Epictetus, the freed slave who taught emperors (PD)
The chains of what we can't control (PD)

plates.query: Caspar David Friedrich calm mountain evening painting

beats.text: Five things Epictetus — born a slave, teacher of emperors — would tell you today.
One. Some things are up to you; most are not. All your peace lives in knowing the line.
Two. It isn't events that disturb you, but your judgements about them. Change the judgement.
Three. Don't explain your philosophy. Embody it. Let your conduct do the arguing.
Four. No one can truly harm you without your own consent to be harmed.
Five. Don't demand that life go as you wish. Wish it to go as it does — and be free.
He owned almost nothing and feared no one. That, he said, is what philosophy is for.

source_note: Inspired by the Enchiridion of Epictetus.
